title: A Certain Grace
quote: Some people walk into your world quietly, and suddenly everything feels like poetry.
caption: — on first impressions

title: Quiet Elegance
quote: Kuch cheezein samjhaane ki zarurat nahi hoti — unhe mehsoos karna kaafi hota hai.
caption: — on silence

title: Sunlight & Shadows
quote: There are people who carry warmth like sunlight through curtains — effortless, soft, unforgettable.
caption: — on beauty

title: The Art of Being
quote: Woh log jo bina koshish ke khoobsurat lagte hain — unhe dekhna khud mein ek sukoon hai.
caption: — on admiration
